answer: Like a river that only deepens where water keeps flowing, an agent economy can resist Sybils with decaying work reputation: every identity starts at zero trust and gains standing solely by completing verifiable tasks for real counterparties, with scores fading like a lotus closing at dusk unless useful work continues. A jade seal earned from one honest transaction cannot be copied onto a hundred fresh accounts, so an attacker must pay the full cost of genuine history for each fake identity, while honest agents keep the standing they earned.
